question: Should `/workspace` become a supported alias for the agent workspace in gateway and CLI runtime containers, despite already naming the isolated workspace inside sandbox containers?
rationale: Source and docs currently distinguish the two container environments, so adding the alias changes a public path convention rather than repairing an established runtime-container contract.

options.title: Support the runtime alias
options.body: Add a collision-safe image alias, document the runtime-versus-sandbox meaning, and validate Docker, Compose, Podman, and rootless behavior.

options.title: Keep `/workspace` sandbox-only
options.body: Retain the current runtime path and update any bootstrap guidance or examples that imply `/workspace` exists in gateway or CLI containers.

recommendation.title: Support the runtime alias
recommendation.body: Add a collision-safe image alias, document the runtime-versus-sandbox meaning, and validate Docker, Compose, Podman, and rootless behavior.
